asset: Traditional Hokkaido carved bear biting salmon v22 - real Harness GLB with Blender Cycles
reviewer: ChatGPT direct visual inspection of actual v22 Blender Cycles multiview and v21/v22 comparison, not image-generation

bear_anatomy_and_silhouette.reason: Quadruped silhouette remains recognizable, but shoulders and back resemble a rigid shell and thigh-to-paw transitions are not convincingly sculpted.

face_and_expression.reason: Small triangular dark nose is better than v20, but snout and eye/ear anatomical structure still looks synthetic.

salmon_shape_and_bite.reason: Fish tail and the head-to-body alignment bend together rather than detach, but the near-front fish still presents as a flat horizontal plank and lower jaw clamp is visually ambiguous.

carving_detail_and_wood.reason: Higher roughness removes part of the waxy shine; deepened cuts now resemble irregular shallow dents instead of directional blade-carved fur.

paws_and_limbs.reason: Feet touch ground without floating parts; paws and forelegs still read as rounded boots, with only weak carved digit anatomy.

multi_view_presentation.reason: Real Blender Cycles front/three-quarter/rear/top renders made from the exact 3DCodeVerse-Harness-produced GLB, captured and compared against v21.

defects.finding: Even after raised jaw edge, fish still appears held against the nose, without a visible bite joint from the front or front-right camera.
defects.required_fix: Stop moving lip/mesh endpoints locally; remodel the whole high-poly muzzle, mouth gap and jaw around an explicit fish intersection profile verified in orthographic front/side.

defects.finding: Deeper stochastic normal displacement produces pitting rather than recognizable grain-following chiselled fur.
defects.required_fix: Define long directional cutting strokes attached to shoulder, belly and flank anatomy, and visually inspect a true high-poly carved sculpt before texture baking.

defects.finding: A curved centerline is a measurable improvement but head, gill and fins still lack the strong landmarks of carved salmon.
defects.required_fix: Use reference-locked front/side fish profiles and visible fish-head gill plates; refine volumetric anatomy before wood materials.

defects.finding: Blocky back, raised cheeks, columnar limbs and boot-like paws still cap realism.
defects.required_fix: Rebuild base anatomy from verified silhouette references, rather than repeatedly deforming the existing primitive-style loft.

improvement_tasks: Successfully fixed Blender Curve.update regression; real v22 GLB generated and all four Cycles views rendered. This is technical success only.
No promotion to latest allowed while blocker/critical defects persist. Continue fail-closed.
Do not keep simply increasing cut depth or random noise; the new pockmarks are not real chisel cuts.
Next modeling track should start with reference-locked silhouette and jaw/fish assembly as distinct high-poly anatomical forms, before retopology, wood shader, or high-res texture.
Use actual reference photos/museum craftsmanship descriptions; never claim they directly authorize reusing a third-party copyrighted model.
